label: Crandall / Long Stretch road junction
phase: Fresh expansion of unchanged affine4 validation; no fitting or model-selection use
point_definition: Centre of the compact northern four-road meeting; the lower crossing and loop are excluded.
identity_evidence: The historical north-south Crandall route meets the west approach from Dorton Bridge and a northeastern route toward the Northwest River corridor. The compact northern road meeting is separated from the lower bridge/triangular road arrangement to the south. The original road and water network has the same northern meeting, western approach and nearby southern crossing. The drawn meeting is generalized; no independently measured bound on local engineering differences is claimed.
